routes.operator_command_template: & { $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo=$null; if(Get-Command sas -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){$repo=(& sas repo 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1)}; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$repo)){$cache=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'SysAdminSuite\repo-root.txt'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $cache -PathType Leaf){$repo=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $cache -Raw).Trim()}}; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$repo)){throw 'SysAdminSuite repo root is unresolved; run sas refresh on Guest/Internet first.'}; $repo=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath(([string]$repo).Trim()); $registryPath=Join-Path $repo 'harness\api\operator-execution-route-registry.json'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $registryPath -PathType Leaf)){throw ('Operator execution route registry missing from resolved repo: '+$repo)}; $registry=Get-Content -LiteralPath $registryPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; $routes=@($registry.routes | Where-Object { [string]$_.id -eq 'autologon-remote-crash-safe' }); if($routes.Count -ne 1){throw ('Expected one autologon-remote-crash-safe route, found '+$routes.Count)}; $route=$routes[0]; foreach($relative in @($route.path_resolution.required_files | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })){$candidate=Join-Path $repo $relative; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Leaf)){throw ('Required operator route file missing: '+$candidate)}}; $helper=Join-Path $repo ([string]$route.operator_helper); if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $helper -PathType Leaf)){throw ('Operator route helper missing from resolved repo: '+$helper)}; Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo; & powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $helper 'HOST_B64'; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
routes.proof_ceiling: Proves only that the operator command resolves a repository location, verifies every registered route dependency, passes an encoded validated target to the tracked route helper, selects the registered crash-safe front door, and propagates its exit code. Live deployment proof comes only from the field-run artifacts.
